protocol.baselines: training position mean (overall fallback); recent three calendar-GW observed minutes (position fallback); recent baseline times chance/100 only when explicitly observed, otherwise unadjusted
protocol.cutoffs: Every fitting label, fitting feature capture, selection label and selection feature capture strictly precedes first forecast capture; all row captures precede their deadlines.
protocol.evaluation_role: historical walk-forward backtest; 2025-26 is a consumed points holdout, not fresh confirmation

exception.policy: GW27 label unavailable; never history or fitting. Mask cumulative minutes for this player from the first evidenced discrepancy through season end; retain independently reconciled later GW deltas. No numeric correction.

feature_contract.asof: accepted capture, strictly before authoritative deadline
feature_contract.availability_changes: current minus immediately preceding GW accepted capture for same season/element; null if either observation missing
feature_contract.cumulative: copy accepted bootstrap minutes/starts only after GW1; GW1 stale prior-season values excluded
feature_contract.downstream: not an xPts input; no in-sample predictions exported; temporal OOS integration deferred
feature_contract.fixture_context: unavailable historically; final fixtures never enter features
feature_contract.history: only earlier GWs with independently evidenced minutes settled at or before capture; last three calendar GWs; missing stays null with counts
feature_contract.minutes_evidence: GW1 settled cumulative after season reset; later GWs settled cumulative minus accepted pre-GW cumulative; exact canonical sum agreement required
feature_contract.population: accepted snapshot football positions 1..4; season-local element; no final identity
feature_contract.schedule_evidence: processed fixtures.csv defines fixture-bearing GWs for labels only; each scheduled fixture requires football-player facts with matching fixture/GW; blanks require schedule absence, never fact absence
feature_contract.target: total realised minutes across all target-GW fixtures; registered nonplayers zero with evidence; globally fixture-empty GW null

protocol.historical_clock: reconstructed information cutoffs, not actual historical computation timestamps or prospective freezes
protocol.prediction_transform: lower bound zero; no 90-minute cap; no hindsight opportunity scaling
protocol.preprocessing: train-only median numeric imputation, all-null computational zero, explicit original missing flags; train-only one-hot position/status, unknown ignored
protocol.refit: Once before first accepted capture of each forecast season; expand from 2021-22 through preceding season; all nonnull evidenced labels; no within-season refit.
protocol.selection: Reuse only M4B bounded candidate selection: fit 2021-22/2022-23, validate 2023-24. No reselection, tuning or prospective outcomes.
